lede: Auburn carries the stronger underlying team rating — +3.9 against +2.2, a 1.7-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Tennessee -9.3 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Tennessee winning 73% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is linebackers, where Auburn leads Tennessee by 108 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 83% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
